description: A level of a tenant's site topology, e.g. a site, an area or a production line. Sites nest into themselves and carry the agents assigned to them.

contents.name: Name
contents.description: Path segment of this site within the unified namespace. Unique among its siblings.
contents.comment: Concatenated with the ancestors' names to form the namespace path, so it is never translated - a path must resolve to the same site in every locale. Localized labels belong in DisplayNames.

contents.name: SiteType
contents.description: Classification of this level, e.g. Site, Area, ProductionLine, WorkCell.
contents.comment: Deliberately a string and not an Enum so a tenant can introduce a level name without a new version of this shared model.

contents.name: DisplayNames
contents.description: Labels shown for this site, keyed by BCP-47 language tag (e.g. en, de, de-AT).

contents.name: Descriptions
contents.description: Descriptions of this site, keyed by BCP-47 language tag (e.g. en, de, de-AT).

contents.name: DefaultLocale
contents.description: BCP-47 language tag of the entry in DisplayNames and Descriptions to fall back to when the requested locale is absent.

contents.name: ChildSites
contents.description: Sites nested directly below this site.
contents.comment: Depth and single-parent are not expressible in DTDL and are enforced by the API: at most six levels below the tenant, and exactly one incoming ChildSites relationship per site.
